_description: Per-row form overrides for regional-variant evolutions. Row id = pokemon_evolution.csv id column. from_form/to_form are 1-indexed and match pokemon_forms.form_order as loaded into species_form_data.

16.note: Pichu -> Pikachu: force form 1 (default) since source may be spiky-eared (form 2) and target form 2 is rock-star cosmetic

17.note: Pikachu -> Raichu: force form 1 since source may be any of 16 cosmetic Pikachu forms and Raichu only has 2 non-mega forms

321.note: Feebas: Prism Scale trade (Gen 6+); redundant with beauty 170 (Gen 3 native)

367.note: Cubone -> Alolan Marowak: Cubone is single-form in our data; Alolan Marowak is not reachable via evolution in this Gen 3 sim

452.note: Galarian Slowpoke -> Galarian Slowbro (Slowbro form 3 = galar; form 2 = mega)

458.note: Galarian Darumaka -> Galarian Darmanitan (Darmanitan form 3 = galar-standard; forms 2/4 are zen battle-only)

465.note: White-striped Basculin -> Basculegion (only form 3 evolves; default to form 1 = male since Basculegion gender split not disambiguated in data)

467.note: Hisuian Qwilfish -> Overqwil (single-form; rows 515/516 are duplicates collapsed by remap dedupe)

511.note: Gimmighoul Chest -> Gholdengo (Roaming form cannot evolve)
